title: Incident Brief: Compact Error Digest & Retry Inspector
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, card-based incident brief within the Redwood Console that surfaces an aggregated error taxonomy, top failed request signatures, recent retry outcomes, and quick payload peek links. The view should be usable inside dashboards and rollout detail panels as a condensed inspector for rapid Triage and remediation steps.
problem_statement: On-call engineers and product owners need a low-noise, high-signal summary that explains why a route or rollout is degrading without opening the full trace viewer. Current consoles require too many clicks to correlate error types, retry behavior, and sample payloads, slowing down MTTR and rollout decisions.
goals: Surface the top 3 error classes for a route / rollout window with lightweight taxonomy labels
Show real retry success/failure ratios and a timeline sparkline for retries
Provide 1-click sample payload 'QuickPeek' that opens an inline expandable inspector (no full page navigation)
Preserve console density so multiple cards can be stacked in dashboards and a rollout sidebar
Expose actionable next steps: open PR, rollback, increase capacity, file incident
ux_constraints: Card footprint must fit 320x200 minimal grid slot
Prefer inline expansion for payload sample (max 600px height) to avoid modal chains
Respect RBAC: hide sensitive payload details for users without payload_preview permission
Must render in mobile console (responsive down to 360px) with truncated labels
acceptance_criteria: Design passes 1:1 review with PM and Eng and addresses accessibility color contrast
Prototype demonstrates inline payload QuickPeek expansion without page navigation
Card explains top error class names, counts, and percentage change vs baseline
Retry graph shows percent successful per retry attempt (first, second, third) and a sparkline of retry volume
Design includes fallback state for when payload preview is redacted or sampling fails
Provides spec for data model needed: top_error_classes[max3], retry_summary{attempts,success_rate}, sample_payload_handle
design_notes: Use three-tier taxonomy chips: category (static), sub-class (dynamic), classifier-confidence indicator
Add contextual help tooltip describing what constitutes an 'error class' (stack signature + model response code)
QuickPeek should show sanitized headers and a redaction banner when PII is detected
When stacked in dashboards, cards collapse to icon-only headers and expand on hover/click
Consider using delta badges (▲▼) to show percent change vs previous window and color-code by severity
tradeoffs: Sampling: showing a single sample payload speeds triage but can mislead; we will include sample provenance and sampling rate metadata
Density vs clarity: tight card fits more signals but requires microcopy to avoid ambiguity; will test with PMs
Privacy vs utility: inline payload preview adds value but increases exposure; enforce RBAC and redaction policies
